## Where `qa`, `run qa`, and `qa agent` are defined

| Layer | Path | Role |
|--------|------|------|
| **Executable skill (Cursor)** | `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\skills\axel-simulated-qa\SKILL.md` | Names `qa` / `qa agent`, modes, default contract (static + playtest), output shape, persistence hints. |
| **Always-on rule** | `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc` | Mirrors aliases, default execution, opt-in after substantive changes, persistence invariant, bot playthrough as separate tier. |
| **Project canon** | `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AI_DOCS.md` (especially §11–12) | Maps `qa agent` / `qa` to the skill + rubric + artifacts; describes default execution and bot integration. |
| **Rubric / commands** | `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md` | Playtest-mode: confidence tiers, **default** command block, pass/fail gates, analytics payload schema. |

**`run qa`** does not appear as a separate keyword anywhere in these files; it is treated as natural language for the same workflow as **`qa` / `qa agent`** (skill + governance both anchor on those spellings).

---

## Exact **current** default behavior

1. **Triggers:** `qa` and `qa agent` are the canonical names (skill frontmatter also mentions “QA simulation” and post-substantive review).  
2. **Plain `qa` / `qa agent`:** **One run = static review + playtest**, unless the user explicitly says **`qa static`** (static-only) or tooling cannot run playtest (must report skipped steps and lower confidence).  
3. **What “playtest” means today:** The rubric’s **“Default command set (playtest: combat + scene smoke)”** — four Godot headless scripts from repo root:  
   `princess_check.gd`, `determinism_check.gd`, `rtp_audit.gd`, `scene_smoke_check.gd`.  
4. **Bots are not in that default set.** `playthrough_arc1_exterior.gd` and `playthrough_dialogue_loop.gd` are documented as **extra** steps for the **`combat + scene smoke + bot playthrough`** tier only.  
5. **Confidence labeling:** The skill’s modes table ties default combined runs to **`combat + scene smoke`** when all relevant gates pass (not the bot tier).  
6. **After substantive AXEL changes:** Governance still says to **ask** whether to run QA; do **not** auto-run unless the user asked for QA in that turn (orthogonal to which commands run once QA is invoked).  
7. **Persistence:** Every `qa` run should append the JSON block to `AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md` and run `tools/qa/update_qa_analytics.py` (invariant in skill, governance, AI_DOCS).  
8. **Output invariants:** Technical-first voice, required sections, **≥3 recommendations**, scores S/N/I/E/C/R, etc., per the skill.

**Note:** `AXEL/axel_project/test/bots/README.md` says bots are “Used by `qa agent` playtest mode”; the rubric still treats them as **optional** unless the highest tier is requested — that is a **wording mismatch** today.

---

## Files / sections to update so **bot playthrough is default** with static + playtest

To make the **two bot scripts** part of the **same default** command bundle as combat + scene smoke (still alongside static review), align at least:

| File | What to change |
|------|----------------|
| **`.cursor/skills/axel-simulated-qa/SKILL.md`** | Modes table (“Combined (default)”): state that default playtest includes **both** `playthrough_*.gd` scripts; update confidence tier text from `combat + scene smoke` to the **full bot tier name** when all gates pass. **§Before you write (playtest)** and **§Default execution contract**: list **six** Godot commands (or explicitly “default rubric block including bots”). Clarify **`qa playtest`** if it stays “same as default” or becomes redundant. |
| **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md`** | **§Confidence tiers:** either promote **`combat + scene smoke + bot playthrough`** to the evidence required for the default combined run, or redefine the **`combat + scene smoke`** tier so it **includes** bots (avoid leaving two conflicting “defaults”). **§Default command set:** merge the bot `.bat` block **into** the default set (not only “also run when bot tier requested”). **§Pass/fail gates:** state bots are **always** gates for plain `qa` when not skipped. **§Analytics snapshot** line: extend allowed **Confidence:** values. **§Persistent analytics payload:** extend `playtest_commands` keys (currently only `princess_check/determinism/rtp_audit/scene_smoke`) to include the two bots — e.g. `bot_arc1_exterior` / `bot_dialogue_loop` (or names you standardize). |
| **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md`** | **§11** (`qa agent` bullets): **Default execution** and **Playtest mode** should say default playtest includes bots; **§11** `bot playthrough` bullet: change **“opt-in … tier”** to **default bundle** (or “always part of default playtest unless skipped”). **§12** first bullet: same. |
| **`.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`** | **Items 11–12:** expand “Playtest-mode commands” to include bot scripts; **Item 20:** change “opt-in … tier” to match new default if bots are always on. |
| **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md`** | Template: **Playtest commands** line + JSON `playtest_commands` example keys + **§Machine-readable analytics** bullet list — add the two bot keys and document `pass|fail|skip`. |
| **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md`** | Optional but useful: extend **“`qa agent` playtest bundle”** with the two bot command lines so combat-focused docs match QA defaults. |
| **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_CHANGELOG.md`** | Per project practice: record the contract change when implemented. |

`update_qa_analytics.py` only uses **`scores`** from payloads for graphs, not `playtest_commands`, so **no parser change is required** for trend charts unless you later add bot-specific metrics.

---

## Conflicts / invariants to preserve

- **QA persistence:** Still one JSON payload per run + `update_qa_analytics.py` (stable key names for anything the parser or humans rely on).  
- **Static-only override:** **`qa static`** should remain **playtest-free** (including bots).  
- **Skip policy:** When Godot or environment is missing, **explicitly skip and report** (skill already requires this); default becoming heavier increases how often skips happen — don’t silently downgrade without saying what was skipped.  
- **`rtp_audit.gd`:** Remains **metrics-only** unless the user sets thresholds (rubric + skill).  
- **Opt-in after substantive edits:** Governance **“ask, don’t auto-run”** stays unless you intentionally change that rule separately.  
- **Canon / voice / recommendations:** Technical-first report, **≥3 recommendations**, taxonomy, `AI_DOCS.md` hierarchy on conflicts — unchanged.  
- **Bot design rules (governance §20):** Real `InputEventKey` via `Input.parse_input_event()`, reuse `input_event_driver.gd` + `scenario_runner.gd`, no API-only shortcuts.

If you want a **lighter** default (combat + smoke **without** bots) to remain available after bots become default, you’d add an explicit alias (e.g. `qa no-bots` or `qa combat-smoke-only`) in the same four primary documents so the contract stays unambiguous.
